summary: Agent roster refreshes classify at most 4096 claim rows per delta and rebuild overflowing deltas through chunked card assembly. Each background roster snapshot has a two-second cooperative wall deadline, including membership and completion reads; expiry releases the reader and retains the previous complete publication.

replay.detail: No persisted projection replay. Overflow rebuilds only the in-memory roster cache from the complete current cut.

rules.detail: No membership, invalidation, retention or checkpoint policy change.

compatibility.detail: No client or wire change. A refresh that exhausts its deadline retains the previous publication until a later refresh succeeds.
